method_notes: IMO resolutions downloaded from wwwcdn.imo.org and parsed with pypdf; COLREG.2 circulars read from the Transportstyrelsen compilation (size-matched to the cached copy); WETREP chartlet rendered with PyMuPDF. WETREP area interpreted as the outer polygon plus closing lines 19-20 (North Sea), 21-22 (St George's Channel) and 23-24 (North Channel), confirmed by dashed lines on Appendix 3; so the Irish Sea is excluded. The 6.2.1 TSS list includes Off Skerries, which lies in the excluded sector: recorded as a conflict and boundary co-ordinates applied. Old (1973) TSS positions used only for gross location tests. Salvamento Marítimo site failed (503/TLS); Spanish currency from a Feb 2025 Ministry publication. UK VTS absence not proven, hence MRS only / Unresolved rather than Neither confirmed. Accessed 29 September 2026.
